title_kr: 『無量壽經宗要』의 ‘佛智에 대한 의혹’ 논의에 나타난 회통 구도 -들뢰즈 사유와의 연관을 중심으로
title_en: Reconciliation Scheme Shown in the Discourse of ‘Doubt on the Buddha’s Cognition’ in the Essentials of the Sūtra of Immeasurable Life: Focusing on the Connection with Deleuze’s Thinking
abstract_kr: 원효(元曉, 617-686)는 『무량수경종요(無量壽經宗要)』에서 불지(佛智)를 의심하 는 4종 중생에 대한 논의를 유식의 4종 불지에 배대 시켜 회통 한다. 우선 일심 과 연계된 4종 불지와 이에 대한 의혹을 해결해야 할 문제와 물음으로 상정한 다. 이로써 불사의지·불가칭지·대승광지와 무등무륜최상승지에 대한 의혹 이라는 물음이 제기된다. 이어서 사구부정과 프라상가(prasaṅga), 불가설과 믿 음 등의 구도를 교차시켜 회통적 해(解)를 제시한다.이러한 특성은 후기 구조주의 철학자 들뢰즈가 제기된 문제로부터 각 계열 을 분화·연계시켜 해를 도출하는 ‘열린 형식의 변증론’과 상통한다. 원효 또 한 불설이나 대승, 일심, 정토와 같은 공통 이념(문제)으로부터 각 부문(계열)을 분화·연계하여 해를 끌어내는 열린 형식의 회통 구도를 보이기 때문이다. 이 는 어떠한 문제라도 고정적 규정을 떠나 비어있는 ‘X’라는 관점으로 회통 하는 상대적 관계론의 사유이다. 이로써 어떤 상반된 주장이나 역설의 의미도 화회 (和會) 될 수 있다. 4종 의혹 중생이나 정토왕생에 대한 논의 또한 고정적 위계 나 입장에 집착함 없이, 대승 선교방편에 따라 모든 논의를 포섭하는 평등 지 향적 특성을 나타낸다.

title_kr: 漢巖의 乾鳳寺와 奉恩寺 祖室 취임과 역할 -<禪院規例>를 중심으로 -
title_en: Hanam(漢巖)’s Inauguration as Josil(祖室) of Geonbongsa(乾鳳寺) and Bongeunsa(奉恩寺) and his Roles : Focusing on 〈Seonwon Gyurye(禪院規例)〉
abstract_kr: In 1912, Hanam attained enlightenment at Woodooam in Mt. Maengsan. However, he began to get fame in September 1921 of the lunar calendar, when he was invited as the Josil of Geonbongsa Manilwon Seonwon(萬日院 禪院). Then, in 1923, he became the Josil of Bongeunsa Temple, and in 1926, he was appointed as the Josil of Odaesan Mountain, and served the Seonwon of Sangwonsa Temple for 26 years. In addition, he became the Gyojong(敎正) and Jeongjong(宗正) for a total of four times in 1929, 1935, 1941, and 1948, securing his status as a high priest representing the period during and after the Japanese colonial period.This paper examines the period of his Josil in Geonbongsa and Bongeunsa during which Hanam became famous in earnest. During this period, the most important document in understanding the methods and perspectives of Hanam’s Seonwon management is the <Seonwon Gyurye>. In this respect, systematic examination of the meaning of the <Seonwon Gyurye> secures important research significance in that it promotes the understanding of Hanam’s management and guidance philosophy of Seonwon during the Geonbongsa and Bongeunsa period.In addition to this, this paper also reviews 3 events in 1925, the last year of his Bongeunsa Josil period: ‘rescue of 708 people in the Great Flood of Eulchuk year’, ‘Bongeunsa Sugye Beophoe(受戒法會),’ and ‘Jo Yong-myeong’s statement on Dongangeo(冬安居).’
abstract_en: 한암은 1912년 맹산 우두암(牛頭庵)에서 깨달음을 얻게 된다. 그러나 한암 의 명성이 드러나기 시작하는 것은 1921년 음력 9월 건봉사 만일원(萬日院) 선 원(禪院)의 조실(祖室)로 초치되면서부터이다. 이후 1923년에는 봉은사 판전(板 殿) 선원의 조실이 되며, 1926년에는 오대산의 조실로 추대되어 26년간 상원사 선원에 주석하게 된다. 그리고 1929·1935·1941·1948년의 총 4차례에 걸쳐 교정(敎正)과 종정(宗正)이 되어 일제강점기의 전후를 대표하는 고승으로의 위 상을 확보한다.본고는 한암이 본격적으로 알려지게 되는 건봉사와 봉은사 조실 기간에 대 해서 검토한 것이다. 이 기간 중 한암의 선원운영 방식과 관점을 알 수 있는 중 요한 문건이 바로 〈선원규례〉이다. 이런 점에서 〈선원규례〉의 의미를 체계적 으로 검토하는 것은, 한암의 건봉사와 봉은사 조실 시기의 선원운영과 지도이 념에 대한 이해를 촉진한다는 점에서 중요한 연구의의를 확보한다.또 이와 아울러서 봉은사 조실 기간의 마지막에 속하는 1925년의 일로 기록 된 3가지 사건. 즉 ‘을축년 대홍수의 708명 人名 구제’와 ‘봉은사 수계법회(受戒 法會)’, 그리고 ‘조용명의 동안거(冬安居) 진술 내용’에 대해서도 검토해 본다.

title_kr: 한국 불교의례에서의 <고성염불>의 전승양상 연구
title_en: A Study on transmission aspects of the <Goseongyeombul> in Korea Buddhist Ritual
abstract_kr: <Goseongyeombul> is a form of Yeombul that is made by shouting at a high pitch, and it is known that it has been actively transmitted mainly in the Chungcheong Province area. After checking this, the worship service of Monk Daecheon, who was the founder of Shinwonsa Temple Beompae in the 20th century, was not in the form of Goseongyeombul.Meanwhile, in 1973, Ilhyun monk’s <The Heart of the Perfection of Wisdom Sutra>, recorded in 1973, did not have any preliminary accompaniment, and the wooden table accompaniment continued strongly, and Yeombul starts at high notes. In other words, the characteristics of Goseongyeombul in Chungcheong-do that are different from the current Jebul are confirmed. In addition, the current Baekje Suryukjae’s Beomjin rarely uses low and mid- range tones and mainly uses only high tones, so it can be seen that the characteristics of Jungje Beompae are well transmitted.  However, Beomjin Monk not only  learned pansori and sijo, and but also learned of Kyeongje- Beompae. In this respect, his sound is considered to be the result of matching the characteristics and disposition of the innate individual along with the characteristics of Jungjebeompae through acquired learning.Muryangsuyeoraehoe, a Yeombulhoe group that is active across the country, plays Goseong-yeombul mainly in NamuAmitabul, and uses drums and little bells as accompaniment instruments. This type of accompaniment is the accompaniment form of Goseong Yeombul held at the Yeombul Meeting in the 19th century, and the Songju of Seonamsa Dawn Yebul is currently in the same form. The Muryangsu Nyoraihoe consists of various methods of Yeombul such as Goseongyeombul, gyeonYeombul, buddhist sermon, NamuAmitabul bow 108 times, Goseongyeombul, going around-Yeombul, sitting-Yeombul, silence, etc. There was a strong aspect of the Comprehensive Yeombul practice, which sought to reach the samādhi of zen by constructing various methods of Confucianism. Nevertheless, the reason why they call it ‘Goseongyeombul’ is considered to be their will and aspiration to engraving the merits of the Confucian liturgical Buddha and to carry on the ceremonial gatherings of the past into the present.
abstract_en: <고성염불>은 높게 질러서 소리 내는 염불의 형태로, 주로 충청도 지역에서 활발하게 전승되어 왔다고 알려져 있다. 이를 확인한 결과, 마곡사 출신 일현 의 경우, 녹음된 음원이 모두 고성으로 노래한 것은 아니었고, 20세기 신원사 범패의 중흥조였던 대천의 예불 또한 고성염불의 형태가 아니었다.한편 1973년에 녹음된 일현의 반야심경은 예비박이 따로 없이 목탁 반주가 강하게 지속되었고, 고음에서 염불을 시작하고 있어서 현재의 예불과는 차별 되는 충청도지역 고성염불의 특징이 확인되었다. 또한 현재 백제수륙재 어장 범진은 중저음은 거의 사용하지 않고 주로 고음으로만 염불을 하고 있어서, 중 제범패의 특징을 잘 전승하고 있다고 볼 수 있다. 다만 범진은 판소리, 시조 및 경제범패의 동교소리와 서교소리를 모두 섭렵하였다는 점에서 선천적으로 타 고난 개인의 특성과 성향이 후천적 학습에 의해 부합된 결과로 여겨진다.전국단위의 염불회인 무량수여래회는 나무아미타불을 중심으로 고성염불 을 하며, 대고와 경쇠를 사용하는데, 이는 19세기 염불결사에서 행한 고성염불 의 반주형태를 잇는 형태이다. 그러나 실제로 고성염불로 노래하는 것은 아니 었고, 고성염불, 경행염불, 법문, 나무아미타불 108 대참회, 고성염불, 경행염 불, 정좌염불, 묵념 등으로 염불의 방법을 다양하게 구성하여 염불 삼매에 이르고자 하는 종합적인 염불수행적 측면이 강하였다.

title_kr: 서구 차크라 체계의 형성 과정 고찰-리드베터(C. W. Leadbeater)의 The Chakras(『차크라』)를 중심으로-
title_en: The Study on The Formation Process of The Western  Chakra System : Focusing on   C.W. Leadbeater’s the Chakras
abstract_kr: What was thought to be an Indian tradition is often a variation formed under the influence of Western esotericism or 19th century occult. This paper examines the initial process of forming the Western Chakra system under the influence of the occultism of the Theosophical Society when the concept of Chakra originated from Tantrism and Indian traditional Haṭha Yoga  was introduced to the West for the first time. Through this, it was revealed that the concept of chakra in modern yoga, which has been misunderstood as a same thing with an Indian tradition, was actually formed by being greatly influenced by the occultism of the the Theosophical Society since the end of the 19th century.To this end, first of all, the process of internalizing Chakra, which was originally an external element of the early Tantra ritual, into the human body for the sake of meditation through Kaula’s reform after the 8th century was briefly examined. Next, we examined the process of introducing Chakra’s concept to the West through The Theosophical Society in the late 19th century, and how it was explained by H.P. Blavatsky.Finally, focusing on The Chakras, C. W Leadbeather’s book, who spread the Chakra concept widely to the Western public, the characteristics of his Chakra concept and its significance in the process of forming the Western Chakra system were examined.
abstract_en: 인도 전통이라고 생각했던 것이 사실은 서구 비교(秘敎, Esotericism)나 19세기 오컬트(Occult)의 영향을 받아 형성된 변형인 경우가 많다. 본 고는 인도 전통 요가의 하나인 하타요가와 탄트라 사상에서부터 발원한 차크라 개념이 서구 에 소개되면서 신지학회의 오컬티즘의 영향을 받아 서구 차크라 체계로 형성 되는 초기 과정을 고찰하였다. 이를 통해 인도 전통으로 알고 있던 현대요가의 차크라 개념이 사실은 19세기 말 이후 신지학회의 오컬티즘에 많은 영향을 받 아 형성된 것임을 밝혔다.이를 위해 먼저 초기 탄트라 의례의 외적 요소였던 차크라가 8세기 이후 카 울라(Kaula)의 개혁을 통해 관상(觀想)을 위해 인체 속으로 내면화되어 6차크 라 체계로 형성되는 과정을 간략히 고찰했다. 그리고 다음으로 19세기 말 신 지학회(The Theosophical Society)를 통해 차크라의 개념이 서구에 소개되는 과 정과 이것이 블라바츠키(H.P. Blavatsky)에 의해 해설되는 과정을 살폈다. 그 리고 마지막으로 차크라 개념을 서구 대중에게 널리 확산시킨 리드베터(C. W Leadbeather)의 저술 『차크라( )』를 중심으로 그의 차크라 개념의 특징 과 서구 차크라 체계 형성 과정에서 그가 가지는 의의를 고찰했다.

title_kr: 陽復子 江謙의 『논어』 해석의 특징 -『論語點睛補注』를 중심으로-
title_en: Characteristics of Interpretation of The Analects Of Confucius with Supplementary Commentary by Jiang  qian(陽復子 江謙), who was an educator of Late Qing  Dynasty and Early Republic of China
abstract_kr: The purpose of this thesis is to analyze the characteristics of the scriptural commentary method used by the educator Jiang qian(1876-1942) in order to solve the main text of Lunyudianjingfǔzhu(論語點睛補注) The hermeneutic basis of Jiang qian’s interpretation of the Analects can be examined from two main aspects: the characteristics of the method of exegesis of the scriptures and the hermeneutic characteristics. In terms of the characteristics of the sutra exegesis method, Jiang qian explained the dictionary meanings of important Buddhist terms such as the ‘Sì xiāng’·’Three Truths’·’Three karma’·’Six chakras’, etc. for those who are new to Buddhism. And he tried to show the point where the teachings of Confucianism and Buddhism communicated with each other. Approaching Jiang qian’s supplementary commentary from the point of view of hermeneutic characteristics, his problem consciousness flowing in all 126 chapters is divided into four major categories. First, he emphasized the asceticism to avoid meat and to be vegetarian. Second, it has been repeatedly mentioned that the spirit of Buddhism’s ‘Seek Bodhi from above, and save sentient beings from below.’ is the prime mover that achieves the ‘Self-cultivation’・’ Family harmony’・’ Governing the State’・’Peace in the world’ as described in the Confucian sutras The Great Learning. Third, he harshly criticized the real politics of China at the time. Lastly, and fourth, the importance of the Pure Land Buddha Discipline was preached. Compared to the original commentary of Ouyizhixu, I think that the educator Jiang qian’s supplementary commentary is a meaningful commentary worthy of consideration from a historical point of view in that it reveals the understanding of the text of the Analects, which has a slightly different texture.
abstract_en: 강겸은 청말민초 시기의 교육자로서, 중국 근대 교육의 선구자이다. 강겸이 우익 지욱의 『논어점정』에 보주를 단 것은 지욱의 정토 염불 법문에 깊은 감명 을 받았기 때문이다. 강겸의 『논어』 해석의 특징은 경전 주석의 특징과 해석학 적 특징 등 두 가지 측면에서 검토해볼 수 있다. 전자의 측면에서 살펴보면, 강 겸은 불교에 처음 입문하는 사람들을 위해서 중요 불교 교리에 관한 사전적인 의미를 풀이하였으며, 각 유교 술어마다 불교의 개념어를 배대하여 유교와 불 교의 가르침이 서로 회통하는 지점을 보이고자 하였다. 후자의 측면에서 접근 하면, 126장의 보주 저변에 흐르고 있는 그의 문제의식은 네 가지로 요약된다. 첫째, 단육식(斷肉食)을 통한 재계를 강조하였다. 둘째, 불교의 ‘상구보리, 하화중 생’의 정신이 『대학』의 수신·제가·치국·평천하를 이룩하는 원동력이라는 점 을 언급하였다. 셋째, 당대 중국의 현실정치를 비판하였다. 넷째, 정토 염불 법문 의 중요성을 시설하였다. 거사 신분의 강겸이 『논어점정』에 단 보주는 지욱의 주 석문과 비교할 때, 그 대의는 방불하면서도 결을 조금은 달리하는 『논어』 이해를 드러낸다는 점에서 경학사적으로 음미해볼 만한 주석문이라고 생각한다.

title_kr: 한국 SGI 지용보살의 공공행복 연구
title_en: A Study on the public conviviality of Jiyong bodhisattva  in Korean SGI
abstract_kr: The purpose of this article is to study on the public conviviality of Jiyong bodhisattva in Korean SGI. The Korean SGI is a kind of Buddhism which was transmitted from Japan in 1960’s. The conviviality of Jiyong Bodhisattva is in a state of profound peace, tranquility and equanimity. Unlike the traditional Korean bodhisattva who persevere in suffering, Jiyong bodhisattva in Korean SGI tries to prove that he would fulfill dharma such as the mutual equipment in ten realms.Firstly. The public conviviality of Jiyong bodhisattva by the mutual equipment in ten realms can be happened. As the Korean SGI has been contributed to activating the private to opening the public conviviality.Secondly, The correlative linkage between three secrets of buddhist law and the public common practice of benefit to others including self interest have contributed to establish public conviviality by the chanting of Lotus Sutra’s title. Thirdly, The correlative linkage between fulfilling buddha’s nature in one lifetime and wide spreading the dharma benefit in the world have contributed to the public conviviality through the perfect harmony among persons. The public conviviality Jiyong Bodhisattva is considered to share life’s goods with others.In addition, it is said that it shows the characteristics of realizing happy public happiness together, breaking away from the priesthood with the modern religious reform spirit without monks through the practice of Jiyong bodhisattva in Korean SGI. Every day, Jiyong Bodhisattva would moves forward to the mundane world and continues to cultivate a sense of community.This article on the basis of public conviviality of Jiyong bodhisattva in Korean SGI, would be a new type of a cosmo-theandric spirituality in the discursive morphology of public conviviality. The Korean SGI can be seen as an Applied Buddhism as the three principle of dharma of the Lotus Sutra.
abstract_en: 본 연구는 공공철학의 방법을 활용하여 한국 SGI 지용보살(地涌菩薩)의 공공 행복 연구를 목적으로 한다. 전대미문의 코로나 사태를 맞이하여 일상이 송두 리째 붕괴되는 상황에서 마스크를 쓰며 ‘자기애(attapiya)’와 ‘타자애(parapiya)’의 관계에 주목한다. 자기보호의 자행(自行)과 타자보호를 염려하는 화타(化他)는 자행화타 ‘공사(公私)’의 관계를 형성한다. 『법화경』에 나오는 지용보살은 고통 을 없애는 발고(拔苦)와 기쁨을 선사하는 여락(與樂)이 ‘일원상(一圓相)’으로 드 러나 다종교문화권에서 문화적 소통을 진작시키는 간문화 역량가치를 나타낸 다. 이에 한국 SGI는 코로나 시대를 맞아 지용보살 역할을 강조하고, 업력장애 (業力障碍)를 법화여락(法華與樂)으로 용해하는 ‘원겸어업(願兼於業)’에 충실함으 로 이체동심(異體同心)으로 인존을 부각시킨다. 또한 진여실상에 도전하여 제 법실상에 다가서고 ‘자행화타(自行化他)’의 공공행복을 부각시킨다.지용보살은 삼덕을 심간(心肝)에 물들이고 공공분노를 공공반야(公共般若)의 지혜로 전환시킴으로, 공공행복을 매개삼아 ‘만인성불’ 목표로 제목창제를 일 상으로 실천한다. 또한 지용보살은 『법화경』의 혼을 ‘광선유포’의 중핵으로 삼 아 인류경애를 불계(佛界)로 승화시키면서 개체생명을 근원적 생명력으로 이 어주고 매개하여 공공철학의 공사공매(公私共媒)의 방편으로 불계(佛界)의 우주 생명력으로 전환하고자 노력한다. 이를 통해 지금 여기서 제법실상을 여실지견으로 깨달아 공공행복을 넓혀 간다. 이에 따라 지용보살 공공행복 구현을 세 과정으로 고찰한다. 먼저 ‘세계광포 시대의 지용보살로서 자아정체성을 찾아 공공행복 구현을 위한 만인성불 서원가치에 주목한다. 또한 제법실상을 추구 하며 업력을 원력으로 용해하고 승화시킴으로 공공분노를 자비원력으로 전환 하여 지금 여기에 법화정토를 구현하고 확산시키고자 신심으로 몰입한다. 그리고  『법화경』의 요체를 ‘만인성불’로 집약하면서 재가신도와 출가 승려 의 신분차이를 극복하고 지용보살로서 ‘지금 내가 ‘묘호렌게쿄’ 당체로서 인존 가치를 표방하며 상호존중 상호호혜의 법위를 확산시켜, 일생동안 즉신성불 (卽身成佛)이 가능하도록 법화신행에 입각하여 ‘행불응신(行佛應身)’을 구현한 다. 자타불이의 동체대비를 지금 여기서 살려 소외되지 않고 차별받지 않도록 지금 여기 살아 움직이는 행불을 선택하고 수범으로 실천한다. 한국전통불교 의 지장신앙과 달리 지용보살 신행은 법화신행의 일환으로 이루어져 삼세윤 회를 한 생애 ‘불계생사(佛界生死)’로 전환시키기에 공공행복에 진력한다. 결국 ‘묘호렌게쿄’ 혈맥을 생사일대사 혈맥으로 전수받고 지용보살의 정체성으로 구현함으로 ‘우주신인론 영성(cosmo-theandric spirituality)’으로 ‘적멸위락(寂滅爲 樂)’을 부각시켜 응용불교의 위상을 나타낸다고 할 것이다.

title_kr: 3·1운동 전후 한용운의 독립사상과 구조
title_en: Before and after the March 1st Movement, Han Yong-un’s Independence Thoughts and Structure
abstract_kr: This paper examines the activities and independence ideas of Han Yong- woon, a Buddhist national representative during the March 1st Movement. At the end of January 1919, Han Yong-woon visited Choerryin and actively proposed the independence movement, creating an opportunity for the Buddhist community to participate in the national coalition front and leading the early stages.After Han Yong-woon was captured, he fought in prison proudly, and wrote an editorial to express his independence. He denied Japanese colonial rule and was convinced of independence. However, the perception of national self-determination and oriental peace theory, despite having insight and insight, also shows somewhat abstract or vulnerability due to excessive expectations or misunderstandings. From a progressive point of view, he emphasized the inevitable collapse of militarism and aggressionism, and strongly criticized Japan and Germany, which pursue socio-evolutionary nationalism.His idea of independence, which had only anti-Bong Geon as a ground task, shows the development process of awareness that was deepening by leading the March 1st Movement. In other words, through the March 1st Movement, he became more aware of the nature of national reality and imperialism, realized the idea and struggle of rebellion as higher concepts to take precedence over those of anti-feudalism, and came to the forefront of the national movement.
abstract_en: 본고는 3·1운동 당시 불교계 민족대표인 한용운의 활동과 독립사상을 살 펴본 것이다. 한용운은 1919년 1월말 최린을 찾아가 먼저 독립운동을 적극적 으로 제안함으로써 불교계가 민족 연합 전선에 동참하는 계기를 만들었고, 초 기 단계를 주도하였다.만해는 피체된 후 당당한 옥중투쟁을 펼쳤고, 논설을 집필하여 자신의 독 립사상을 피력하였다. 그는 일제의 식민지 지배를 부정하고 독립을 확신하였 다. 그러나 민족자결주의나 동양평화론에 대한 인식은 통찰력과 혜안을 지니 고 있었음에도 불구하고 다소 추상적이거나 지나친 기대나 오해로 인한 취약 성을 보이기도 한다. 그는 진보주의적 관점에서 군국주의와 침략주의의 필연 적 멸망을 강조하였고, 사회진화론적 국가주의를 추구하는 일본과 독일을 강 력하게 비판하였다.이 같은 그의 독립사상은 반봉건만을 지상과제로 하였던 그가 불교자주화 운동을 통해 반제사상이 형성되었고, 3·1운동을 주도하며 심화되는 인식의 발전과정을 보여 주는 것이다. 곧 그는 3·1운동을 통해 민족적 현실과 제국 주의의 본질을 더욱 깊이 인식하며 반제사상과 투쟁을 반봉건의 그것보다 우 선하여야 할 상위개념으로 깨닫고 민족운동의 전면에 나서게 되는 것이다.

title_kr: 이혜화 지음 『정산 송규 평전』의 구조와 성격
지방소멸위기 극복방안 - 전북 익산시를 중심으로 -
정산 송규의 개벽사상과 그 전개 - 일원개벽(一圓開闢)에서 삼동개벽(三同開闢)으로 -
abstract_kr: The task given to us by modern times can be said to be the theory of the Double Project of Modernity which describes the process of simultaneously adapting to and overcoming modernity. In terms of Korea’s response in the modern era, there was a third trend that could be called the Gaebyeok group in addition to the Cheoksa and Gaehwa groups, which needs to be noted in terms of a solution to the double task. The flow of the great opening or Gaebyeok has flowed since Donghak leads to the movement of Great Opening of Spirit of Sotaesan Park Jung-bin, Great Master. Jeongsan, who succeeded Sotaesan, led Won-Buddhism during the chaotic period after Japanese colonial rule and Koreas independence. And he mastered not only the traditions of Confucianism, Buddhism, and Taoism but also scientific ideas, and inherited and developed Sotaesan’s thought of great opening.In a word, Sotaesan’s thought of great opening can be summarized as a great opening of faith, practice, and life, centering on the Ilwonsang’s truth, and it can be seen that Sotaesan’s thought of great opening is developing in four aspects, focusing on Samdong ethics. The first is the opening of spirituality. Jeongsan , who inherited the “Ilwonsang theory,” the core of Sotaesan thought, presented the “Yeoung-Gi-Jil theory” that all beings are composed of spirit, energy, and matter by combining the essence of the Confucianism, Buddhism, and Taoism and modern scientific thought. The second is the great opening of daily life. The Sejeon, an article left by Jeongsan, presented the norms that we should follow throughout our lives, making our daily life a life of great opening. The third is the great opening of the state. After Koreas independence he suggested a plan to build a new state through the National Foundation Theory or Geonguk-Lon from the perspective that politics and religion should move forward with a mind that is for the country. The last is the great opening of ethics. Jeongsan was proposed as a world universal ethics that all mankind should practice together through “Samdong Ethics”, which is a practical ethics, revealing that all religions are one source, that all living things are one energy, and that all businesses are one work.Through this, it is possible to confirm the development of the Won-Buddhist great opening thought from Ilwon Gaebyeok or the great opening through Sotaesan’s Ilwonsang Truth to Samdong Gaebyeok or the great opening by Jeongsan’s Samdong Ethics. The Samdong Gaebyeok of Jeongsan is a solution to the Double Project of Modernity of adapting to and overcoming modernity, suggesting an moderate and public practical alternative for the great opening of society, the state, and the world as well as the spiritual and daily opening of individuals.
keywords_en: National Foundation Theory or Geonguk-Lon (建國論)
The Great Opening of Truth or Il-Won Gaebyeok (一圓開闢)
The Great Opening of Ethics or Samdong Gaebyeok (三同開闢)

title_kr: 쇼펜하우어와 원불교의 대화 - 숭산 박길진의「실재의 연구」(1941)를 중심으로 -
abstract_kr: Sungsans thoughts can be divided into the first half and the second half, starting with the graduation from Dongyang University in Japan in 1941. The first half was taught Korean Gaebyeok(開闢) by Sotaesan, Soongsan’s father, while the latter half was the period of training in Western Gaehwa(開化) at Baejae High School and Dongyang University.However, he did not miss the point of view of Gaebyeok while practicing Gaehwa, and nor reject Gaehwa while doing Gaebyeok Learning. In that sense, Sungsan can be said to be a well-balanced thinker since childhood. The fruit of such a balance is The Study of Reality - Focusing on Schopenhauer, which was submitted as a graduation thesis at Dongyang University in 1941. This thesis can be said to be both comparative and critical philosophy that accepted and criticized Gaehwa from the perspective of Gaebyeok.“A Study on Reality” has two major philosophical meanings. First, it is a pioneering study on Schopenhauer philosophy by Korean in the early 20th. Second, it is the first dialogue between Schopenhauer and Won Buddhism. At that time, it was not easy for a Korean to write a thesis on Schopenhauer. In that sense, “A Study on Reality” has a pioneering meaning in terms of the history of Schopenhauer research by Koreans.Furthermore, from the point of view of the history of East-West comparative philosophy, “A Study on Reality” is the first thesis to attempt a dialogue between Won Buddhism and Western philosophy. Such an attempt would have been possible because Songsan had mastered all aspects of Eastern and Western philosophy at Dongyang University. Moreover, “A Study on Reality” contains the prototype of the later Songsan thought. “The Study on Il-Won-Sang” published in 1967 is also based on “Study of Reality.” His educational thought, moral theory, and religious theory are added to this, forming a Sungsan philosophy. In this respect, the historical value of “A Study on Reality” - not only in the history of Won Buddhism thought, but also in the history of Korean modern thought - cannot be overemphasized.

title_kr: 『능가경』의 意生身 증득의 원리와 果相에 대한 고찰
abstract_kr: The mind-made body 意生身 (Skt. manomaya-kāya) refers to the immaterial body produced in the stage of the bodhisattva. Existing research on the mind-made body has been focused on the conceptual meaning, but not on the ontological aspects. This paper examines the principles of acquiring the mind-made body and its results, as preached in the Lengjia jing.First, I found out that there are two principles operating in the acquisition of the mind-made body: the ‘samādhi wherein one observes that all phenomena lack inherent existence’ 如幻三昧 (Skt. maya-upamā-samādhi) and the wisdom of realizing that ‘all things are beyond birth and death’ 無生法忍 (Skt. anutpattika-dharma-kṣānti).Second, I discovered that the results of these samadhi and wisdom are embodied into the three kinds of mind-made bodies: the first is the body produced from the enjoyment of samādhi 三昧樂三摩跋提意生身; the second is the body produced from awakening to the real character of all dharmas 如實覺知諸法相意生身; and the third is the body produced by various types of beings together functioning without effort or obstruction 種類生無作行意生身.
keywords_en: the ‘sam?dhi wherein one observes that all phenomena lack inherent existence’ 如幻三昧 (Skt. maya-upam?-sam?dhi)
the wisdom of realizing that all things are beyond birth and death 無生法忍
the meditative attainment of total cessation 滅盡定 (Skt. nirodha-sam?patti)
sharpness and toterance of accordance 明利順忍

title_kr: 아귀의 業因과 苦痛相, 그리고 구제의례 - 불교문헌을 중심으로 -
abstract_kr: This paper examines references to agwi (hungry ghosts) in historical Buddhist texts, including karma causes in the agwi realm, the form of agwi, descriptions of agwi in torment, and practices and rituals for aiding agwi. This paper also pays particular attention to doctrinal transformations that occurred in the transition from Indian Buddhism to Mahayana Buddhism.It appears that as time has progressed, the scope of the causes of karma, which were at first limited to greed and heretical beliefs, have expanded. Moreover, as time passes, descriptions of agwi in Buddhist scriptures have become more diverse, and it can be seen that their appearances have been represented as increasingly grotesque. Images of agwi in pain in torment, which have appeared since early Buddhism, have also diversified and become more established as time has passed.Doctrine on agwi as well as redemption for evil acts and karma causes concerning agwi has naturally emphasized the need for practices and rituals of honor and respect in order to avoid falling into the agwi realm. The method of offering a prayer to save the dead through the power of the vow of the Buddha and Boddhivistas has been realized through the practice of repentance and Buddha chanting. In document appearing later, practices such as offering food to agwi, the reciting or transcribing of mantras and Buddhist scriptures appeared.After the Tang and Song Dynasties, in the majority of food-offering rituals documented in collections of Buddhist ritual texts in East Asia, it appears that through Pure Land Theory and merit-oriented belief, offering a prayer for rebirth in the Pure Land was reinterpreted and incorporated in an expanded manner into rituals for assisting agwi. Whereas early Buddhist texts mention rituals aimed at the birth of the agwi in heaven, later texts reference the eternal peace of the agwi in the Pure Land. In the end, these changes in the understanding of the Pure Land are naturally reflected in the ritual texts of agwi food-offering rituals that have been modified and adapted in different places throughout Korea.

title_kr: 指空의 나란타사 출가와 수학 양상 분석
abstract_kr: Jigong(指空) stayed in the Yuan Dynasty and influenced a lot on Goryeo Buddhism through disciples such as Naong Hyegeun(懶翁惠勤) and many others. Starting with Jigong, Korean Buddhism in Late Koryo Dynasty and Early Choson Dynasty faced a huge change and Jigong has an important position in the early history. However, studies which have been conducted so far are only based on Jigong’s assertions. Thus, this study tries to look critically with an objective perspective.Jigong left home to temple in Nālandā at the young age of eight to heal the incurable disease of his father king. However, the historical timeline around Jigongs birth is commonly known as the collapse of Indian Buddhism. And it raises the question of whether Nālandā, where Jigong left to from his homeland, was a normal environment, and it makes us think of the possibility that the place actually existed or not. In fact, the history recorded that Jigong studied Tripitaka and other 96 kinds of studies, but he studied mainly sutra(經). Therefore, in this study, we would like to clearly identify the historical background of Jigong’s birth and based on this, we try to approach the actuality of Nālandā. In addition, we can also look into the studying environment and the characteristics of Jigong through the studying contents found in the historical record of temple in Nālandā. Jigong who studied under Vinaya-bhadra(律賢), eventually looked for Samanta-Prabhāsa(Bomyeong, 普明) in order to study in depth about prajñā(般若學). In this regard, we can guess the Buddhistic circumstances in Nālandā and Sri Lanka at the moment. In other words, we can reflect on how the Buddhists environment in Nālandā was like.Examining Jigong’s footprint in Nālandā and his studying history is very meaningful and distinguished analysis because all the prior studies were indiscriminately accepted primary data. In this respect, we would like to reconsider the features of Jigong’s footprint in Nālandā and his studying history from a new perspective.

title_kr: 고려 천태종의 법사종과 소자종의 성립에 관한 연구
abstract_kr: After Daegak Guksa Uicheon(義天) first established the Tientai school of Buddhism in Korea, the terms Tientai-Sojajong (天台疏字宗) and Tientai-Beopsajong (天台法師宗) appeared in the Joseon dynasty era. This article examines the various controversial allegations and claims about the Tientai sect and sheds light on the truth behind the Tientai Soja.The origin of the Korean Buddhist sects has been consistently discussed through the Seonmun (禪門) Gusan (九山), which was accomplished in the late-Silla period, the “five doctrinal and two meditational schools (五敎兩宗),” and what is known as Uicheon’s Six Schools of Buddhism (六學宗).First, all of the previous six sects mentioned in academic studies––Yeolban, Gyeyul, Beopsung, Hwaeom, Beopsang, Sunjeok––are not Buddhist sects that existed in Goryeo but rather were scholarly terms being studied by academia and the names of the sects in Song China where Uicheon was studying Buddhism.Meanwhile, there is no evidence for the 12-sect theory of Tientai, Tientai Soja, or Tientai Beopsa in the religious consolidation during the early Joseon Dynasty era; they were misunderstood as the 11 sects mentioned in “The Annals of King Taejong.” Looking at both previous religious sect studies and the newly discovered history of Tientai, it seems that Tientai had already divided into Tientai Soja and Tientai Beopsa in the late Goryeo Dynasty. Tientai’s Baekryeonsa Temple(白蓮寺) in Gangjin during the late Goryeo period used “Beophwa Sammaechamui” as a training book, “Myobeop Yeonhwagyeong” as a foundational sutra, and “Haedongjeon Hongrok” as the certificate of divine conduct. In addition, the Myorunsa Temple (妙蓮寺) in Gaegyeong used thenewlydiscovered“Myobeop Yeonhwagyeong Sammae Chambeop” as a training book, “Beophwa Sammae Reference Zen Lecture” with an interpretation of “Beophwamungu” as a guidebook, and “Beophwa Yeongheomjeon” (Record of Responsive Manifestations of theLotusSutra) as the certificate of divine conduct. Therefore, we can make the connection that the Baengryeongsa Temple lineage is close to the Tientai Beopsa sect and the Myoreonsa Temple lineage is close to the Tientai Soja sect.

title_kr: 동아시아에서 대승불교 전환의 사례로서 『삼국유사』 기사 검토
abstract_kr: The most studies about Samguk yusa have focused on the meanings and the effects on the society at that time. More studies on the historical trends of Buddhism can be fulfilled with looking into deeper meanings of the articles and integrating them.In Samguk yusa, from the view of Buddhist history, there were some point in time when the religion made development from the earlier form which had reckless acceptance.Since ancient dynasties in Korea all accepted Buddhism as national religion, the research about the subject when and how the development took places is required.This study assumes that Silla was the first dynasty to evolve Buddhism in both records and reality. Even though Silla accepted the religion the last in Korea peninsula, there were some signs telling Silla took Buddhism from India directly not from China. Also some articles emphasized that Silla was the only nation of Kasapa-Buddha which is Buddha’s previous existence. That can be the answer why Silla was known as Buddha-related nation.This study is about how Silla had tried to solve and accept the problems appeared while Mahayana had taken over East Asia.

title_kr: 兩亂 이후 碧巖 覺性의 佛敎中興
abstract_kr: Byeokam Gakseong is a disciple of Buhyu Seonsu(浮休善修) and Cheongheo hyujeong(淸虛休靜), who represented Buddhism in the mid-late Joseon Dynasty. He studied the study of zen and non-zen Buddhism under his master for 30 years and became an example for practitioners. During the Imjin War(壬辰倭亂) and the Jurchens(丙子胡亂), he participated in the war, built a fortress, and did not neglect the defense. His deeds for national protection were an opportunity to reaffirm that the monks were the people of the dynasty. The king gave him title and praised him for his hard work. the work of building and defending the fortress became the basis for various reconstruction projects that later reconstructed many temples and created statues of Buddha. It has become a systematic and efficient organization. Byeokam Gakseong has restored many temples, including Suncheon Songgwangsa, Wanju Songgwangsa, Hwaeomsa, Beopjusa, and Ssanggyesa, together with Buhyu Seonsu. He and his disciples effectively completed the temple reconstruction project in many regions including Jeolla Province and Gangwon Province. Such efforts contributed to the revival of Buddhism, which had been oppressed and marginalized. Byeokam Gakseong also published books necessary for the training and education of monks, laying the foundation for active Buddhist studies. He also solved the doubts and misunderstandings of monks by writing about the practice. In the end, Byeokam Gakseong is a representative figure who protects the country and revives Buddhism along with Cheongheo hyujeong.
keywords_en: Byeokam Gakseong Buhyu Seonsu Namhan-sansung(南漢山城) temple reconstruction Monk Army(僧軍) monk master(僧匠)

title_kr: 조선후기 水陸齋文에 나타난 불교음식 연구
abstract_kr: The characteristics of Buddhist food were found in the original text of Jihwan(智還)s 『CheonjiMyeongyangsuryukjaeieubeomeumsanbojip』 of Yugsaegjangchugwon-text. In the late Joseon Dynasty for Suryukjae, the period of installation and the mandala of installation are gradually decreasing. The reason is interpreted as a phenomenon to reduce the economic burden. Although the economic scale of Seolhaeng is reduced, the job of preparing food is systematized using Korean terminology. This characteristic can be interpreted as shifting to the recognition of rituals using food as a medium rather than the meaning of Suryukjae recognized in China. In this process, the importance of offerings is emphasized, and the name of the Yuksaekjang(六色掌) is accepted. The job of making offerings to be prepared in Suryukjae was called Yuksaekjang. And it can be judged that it was established before 1600s.Yuksaekjang is an artificially made confection that person who cooks(飯頭), artificially made confection(造菓), rice cake maker(造餠), tea brewer(茶角), person who stews fruits in honey and sesame oil(熟頭), person who cooks soup(菜露). Although it is not Yuksaekjang, Byeoljwa(別座) prepares ingredients and tools so that Yuksaekjang can make what she wants. Yuksaekjang determines how to cook. Person who cooks is for steaming grains, artificially made confection for kneading and frying grain powder, rice cake maker for steaming grain flour, tea brewer for boiling tea, person who stews fruits in honey and sesame oil for boiling roots and fruits with honey, and person who cooks soup for boiling in water. Foods are rice, honey and oil, rice cake, tea, and stewed fruit and root vegetable.In this way, the Yuksaekjang is organized according to the cooking method. And it can be judged that it is a characteristic of Korean Suryukjae that the name of Yuksaekjang does not appear in Chinese scriptures or commentaries.
keywords_en: a person who stews fruits in honey and sesame oil

title_kr: 일제시기 조선불교계 승려 결혼에 관한 고찰 -1925~1927년 조선총독부 조선 사찰 관련 문건철을 중심으로-
abstract_kr: The Main Temple Ordinance enacted in 1911 was a modern apparatus the Japanese Government-General of Korea prepared for facilitating the control over Joseon temples. Accordingly, to be a chief priest of a temple, one should get approval from the Japanese Government-General of Korea, and the qualification was limited to celibate monks. This restriction was lifted by the revision of the jurisdiction of the root and branch in 1926. As the qualifications that only celibate monks could be chief priests were alleviated, monks who were married, in other words, married priests, too, could be chief priests of temples and were given the right to vote chief priests as well. This study examined and analyzed documents of the Japanese Government-General of Korea concerning the Joseon Buddhist Circles around 1926. Studies until now point out that the 1926 revision of jurisdiction provided a foothold for an increase in the number of married priests, and married priests who became chief priests began appearing at this time too. However, this study examined these files and found that married priests took office as chief priests already before the revision of jurisdiction in 1926. This study would investigate these facts and shed new light on the debate over monk’s marriage viewed only from the “Pro-Japan-Anti-Japan” scheme, bearing the situations of the time in mind.

title_kr: 〈천수경 대합창곡〉으로 본 찬불가의 방향성
abstract_kr: This essay examines the Buddhist hymn “The Choral Song of The Thousand Eyes and Hands Sutra” and makes the following suggestions concerning the future of Buddhist hymns.First, the performance of Buddhist hymns must be developed to allow for a variety of musical forms of communication. That is, Buddhist hymns require the musical flexibility and communicability necessary to respond to social changes and the needs of the public. Second, due to the COVID-19 pandemic, it is often said that so-called “ontact” interactions and the digital era have arrived; likewise, there is a need for Buddhist hymns that can be distributed on social networks. A mainstream example of this is healing meditation music spread on social media networks. Third, There is a need for young, new, and entertaining ways to spread Buddhist hymns. For example, similar to Christian gospel songs and the genre of contemporary Christian music, Buddhist music also needs to develop a roster of well-known singers and a culture for disseminating popularized Buddhist hymns. Fourth, it is necessary to nurture professional songwriters who can incorporate the teachings of the dharma into the music and lyrics of songs in a way that responds to the emotions and needs of the public. Fifth, it is necessary to break away completely from the existing format of Buddhist hymns to create Buddhist hymns that reflect a pan-religious orientation without regard for genre distinctions.In summary, future Buddhist hymns must become a musical genre that takes everyday people as its central characters.
keywords_en: The Choral Song of The Thousand Eyes and Hands Sutra

title_kr: 불교의 생명평화 사상과 운동 - ‘생명평화결사’와 『생명평화경』 그리고 ‘생명평화 백대서원 절 명상’
abstract_kr: In this article, I would like to review Buddhisms Life Peace thoughts and movements. First, I am going to summarize Buddhisms idea of Life Peace, and then examine the ‘Life Peace Association’, Life Peace Sutra, and ‘Bow Meditation of Life Peace One Hundred Wishes’ as contemporary examples.In the case of Buddhism, it is basically a teaching of mercy that values Life and Peace, and it can be said that it is a teaching for all living beings and all people. It is embodied through the ideas of ‘Sasaeng’[The four forms in which living things are born], ‘Yukdo’[Six Worlds: hell, monkfish, animal, sura, human beings, heaven], and ‘Samsara’[the eternal cycle of birth, death, and rebirth]. According to Buddhisms view of time, We can imagine and obtain an open vision of ‘Life Eequality’.The spirit of ‘Life Peace Association’ is well expressed in the Life Peace Pledge, and the Life Peace Logo symbolizes it. Furthermore, it presents an ideal world called ‘Daedong World of Life Peace’. Life Peace is new, but its spirit is also connected to the fundamental doctrine of Buddhism. The term ‘Association’ has the orientation of Buddhisms reform and innovation movement.The Life Peace Sutra consists of the World View, Social View, Human View, and Practice asceticis of Life Peace, and they are organically connected to each other. The Life Peace Sutra does not insist on only Buddhism or Buddhist theory. It is unique that it comprehensively reflected the common worldviews based on the reality of existence such as Buddhism, Christianity, Islam, Hinduism, Donghak, Won Buddhism, and Eastern philosophy, modern science, and etc.. It also shows an open attitude toward neighboring Religions.‘Bowing Meditation of Life Peace One Hundred Oaths’ is to think deeply and savor each one while bowing and meditating the One Hundred Oaths to make Life Peace intact. We think that we can heal and solve the problems of our bodies and minds and real life by choosing a way of bowing and meditating so that the body and mind become one with extreme sincerity. It can be said that it is the theory of performing Life Peace.While following the fundamental spirit of Buddhism, they may be seen as preaching the words and teachings of Buddha in the current language according to the times and circumstances. It allows us to think of the momentum of Tradition and Innovation in Buddhism.
keywords_en: Bowing Meditation of Life Peace One Hundred Oaths

title_kr: 『관자』의 음양오행이론에서 ‘時’와 ‘政’의 合一과 ‘四時五行循環圖式’에 관한 연구
abstract_kr: In this thesis, in the theory of Yin-Yang Wu-Xing(陰陽五行) in Guan-Zi, this thesis studied the confluence of Yin-Yang and Wu-Xing, the unity of ‘seasonal change(時)’ and ‘policy(政)’, and the ‘Four seasons-Wu-Xing-Circulation Diagram(四時五行循環圖式)’. Yin-Yang and Wu-Xing started and developed from different backgrounds, but only joined together in Guan-Zi.In Guan-Zi, the first place to suggest the merging of Yin-Yang and Wu-Xing and the unity of ‘seasonal change(時)’ and ‘policy(政)’ is 「You-Guan」. In 「Si-Shi」, ‘Four seasons was placed in the Mu(木)-Huo(火)-Jin(金)-Shui(水), and Tu(土) was assigned between summer and autumn. In 「Wu-Xing」, 360 days of a year are allocated to each of Wu-Xing by 72 days. The greatest characteristics of 「Qing-Zhong-Ji(輕重己)」 is that the year is divided into Eight-Seasons(八節). Based on the concepts related to the Yi-Wei(易緯)’s knowledge system, a World- Diagram(世界圖式) can be derived that unites the heaven and earth and people according to the order in which the celestial bodies move and the four season’s perspectives cycle. This Diagram establishes the cyclical coexistence of Yin-Yang and Wu-Xing as a basic concept and reflects the ideological system that encompasses the fusion of ‘seasonal change(時)’ and ‘policy(政)’. In this thesis, this is referred to as ‘Four seasons-Wu-Xing-Circulation Diagram(四時五行循環圖式)’
keywords_en: Four seasons-Wu-Xing-Circulation Diagram(四時五行循環圖式)

title_kr: 『滴天髓闡微』에 함축된 ‘精氣神’ 고찰 - 任鐵樵注를 중심으로 -
abstract_kr: Yangsaengga(養生家) has regarded ‘Jeonggisin(精氣神)’ as very important as three jewels (三寶), the root of human life, since ancient times. And the logic of circulation of mutual aid was always emphasized in Jeonggisin. The Jeonggisin theory (精氣神論), In the previous generation (先天), attention was paid to the relationship between the metaphysics of heaven and earth inclusive of each other (天地萬物), and in the later generation (後天), attention was paid to connecting nature and the human body and arranging them sequentially. But one common feature is that both the previous and later generations (先後天) put the emphasis on ‘Application of logics of circulation’ into Jeonggisin.Jeokcheonsucheonmi (滴天髓闡微) is a book (命理書) that tries to capture this notion of Jeonggisin, and the core is in the theories of Neutralization (中和論) and Jeonggisin. In other words, it focused on understanding a person’s fate (運命) in an organic structure and ‘getting Saenghwa(生化) by Yutong(流通)’. Yet, unfortunately, Jeonggisin was not described systemically. So, the disorderly and mixed meanings in Jeokcheonsucheonmi was considered from the contemporary viewpoints.In this study, ‘The theory of Jeonggisin’ was examined based on the content that Won, susan(袁樹珊) evaluated Ohaeng(五行)’s Saenggeug(生剋)·Soewang(衰旺)·Jeondo(顚倒) logic as “It is appropriate to do Geug(剋) for what is Wang(旺), but if it is too Wang, it is appropriate to do Seol(洩). For Yag(弱), it is appropriate to do Saeng(生), but if it is too Yag, it is appropriate to do Geug. The meaning of these two articles is the greatest and deepest.” in 〈Wonseo(袁序)〉 of Jeokcheonsucheonmi.Considering that Jeonggisin combines Jeonggi(精氣), Singi(神氣), and Jeongsin(精神), in 〈Cheongan(天干)〉·〈Hyeongsang(形象)〉·〈Jeongsin(精神)〉·〈Gwansal(官殺)〉·〈Cheonggi(淸氣)〉 of 「Tongsinron(通神論)」 in Jeokcheonsucheonmi , the text on the explanation of Saju(四柱) or fate, and 〈Hajijang(何知章)〉·〈Jilbyeong(疾病)〉·〈Jiwi(地位)〉 of 「Yukchinron(六親論)」, it is emphasized that the fundamental root (元氣) should be established (通根), so that vitality can be circulated in Saju or fate and fortune, evenly, without biased toward a single element (中和).In addition, it was found that in case Im, Cheolcho’s annotations (任鐵樵注), the overall circulation structure was grasped by whether it took root or not (有無), and if it took root, the characteristic of ‘Jeonggisin theory’ was revealed, not discussing the rigidity and weakness of Ilgan[日干·日主]. Before we look at the fate of a person (命) with Kyukguk(格局) and Yongsin(用神), if we think of Jeonggisin theory and Neutralization theories first, perhaps the margin of error is small and logical inference is possible.
keywords_en: Sajumyeongli (四柱命理) (Theories of Human Life Fate)

title_kr: 생태영성학(Study of Eco-Spirituality)의 구상
abstract_kr: Behind the feelings of loneliness that humans are experiencing now in the Corvi- Era, there is a survival strategy through social assistance and solidarity. Through the excellent adaptation of man to nature, man has been freed by separating his mind from nature, and through the activity of the mind, the idea of self, society, and relationship is created, transcending individual life, and building history and civilization. Therefore individual identity can be created by the relationship with others, and there must be the society in order to realize personal happiness, And all members of the society want to be treated equally and fairly. Furthermore, human beings solve the problem of their own existence and complete their desires by assuming and aiming for a transcendental absolute as well as relationships with all non-human beings. However, as the nature and human beings have been separated since the modern industrial revolution and human exploitation of nature has intensified, the earth system is furious and retaliatory against humans, leading to a climate crisis and extinction of species. To overcome this crisis, the key is whether we can interpret the evolution of life on Earth and the progress of the mind(human soul) in the principle of a unified orientation, and whether we can provide a practical path for reconciliation between the nature and humans even if freedom is limited. In this small thesis, I tried to ground up the study of ecology spirituality as a horizon where the evolution of life on Earth and the progress of the mind (consciousness) are integrated. Eco spirituality preserves the vitality of the earth and makes humankind responsible for the diversity of the species that sustain their life on the earth, and becomes a place of academic communication in which humans will and progressively strive to become a sustainable human civilization. The thesis that preserving the existence and value of all living things on Earth is in the era of earth-crisis the Categorical Imperative will be grounded in the thesis that it is the Creators Order to the humankind evolved in mind and will.

title_kr: 3·1독립선언서 국외 전파자 V. S. 맥클래치
abstract_kr: On March 1, 1919, in the name of 33 National Representatives, the Declaration of Independence was announced that the Korean people escaped from Japanese colonial rule and were independent countries and independent people. It was V.S. McClatchy, a renowned American journalist who spread the English version of the Declaration of Independence, which was the starting point of the March 1st Movement.McClatch has been in Seoul for two and a half days since March 3, 1919, when the March 1st Movement took place. During his stay in Seoul, he not only saw the independence movement of Koreans in person, but also took pictures and covered the scene where crowds gathered and protested on a rickshaw. In addition, McClatch secretly hid the Declaration of Independence obtained from Seoul and played a role in informing the outside world.The Declaration of Independence he brought from Seoul was also provided to media organizations in Tokyo, Japan, and took it to the Americas and published on March 28, 1919, the Hawaiian English newspaper The Pacific Commercial Advertiser. And in North America, he first published a full text on April 3, 1919, when he was the publisher of Sacramento Bee. A copy of the Declaration of Independence he brought to the United States was also provided to the Associated Press, making it widely known to the world that Korea declared independence.In addition, McClatch accurately published the situation of the Korean independence movement he witnessed in Seoul in Sacramento Bee, where he was the publisher, and praised the March 1st Movement as the greatest example of passive resistance organized for the ideal in world history. He spread the reality of the March 1st Movement to the American media, and published a newspaper article about the March 1st Movement he wrote himself in the booklet The Germany of Asia to publicize the Korean independence movement.After the March 1st Movement, McClatch also played a role in promoting the Korean independence movement while interacting with Koreans in the Americas. The presidents of the Korean Provisional Government, Syngman Rhee and McClatch frequently exchanged letters, and Syngman Rhee expressed gratitude for helping the Korean independence movement.McClatch supported the Korean independence movement in the United States and steadily interacted with the independence movement forces, so he was called a good friend in the Korean society.

title_kr: 숭산 박길진 박사 논저해제
『대종경』(초편본) 발굴에 대한 고찰 Ⅰ
원행 스님의 『성인 한암 대종사』에 부치는 글
원불교「참회문」의 연구 -『불교정전』과『정전』의 비교를 중심으로
abstract_kr: Humans are the divine beings of all beings because they are animals that know how to repent of their mistakes. They are also the existence of rational thoughts that induces a desirable personality through repentance by a right conscience. Therefore, we, who have the wisdom to make tools and understand languages, need to expand the self-esteem of their existence as human beings through reflection on their actions.Each religion mentions a lot about repentance to help restore self-esteem as a divine being. The methods such as Christianity’s confession and Buddhism’s upasadhā and pravāraṇā are a way of inducing repentance. Sotaesan, the Founding Master of Won-Buddhism, suggested The Instruction of Repentance in Kyojeon of Won-Buddhism is to make followers repent of their past mistakes and to induce a life of pioneering a new life. This would be to get away from the bad karma created by the three karmas of body, speech, and mind and build up a good karma of mutual benefits and good karmic relationships.This study explored the meanings and formation process of repentance. By comparing the contents of the two versions of The Instruction on Repentances from Bulkyo Jeongjeon, the early text, and Jeongjeon, the latter text published by gathering of scriptures, this study critically approaches whether there are any problems with it. It focused on two discussions as a solution to the problem that appeared in The Instruction on Repentance. The first is the hermeneutical task. The second is a direction with the possibility of regathering of scriptures in the future.

title_kr: 원불교 경전연습 방법론 제언 - 기독교의 큐티 사례와 성인학습자 특성을 중심으로 -
abstract_kr: The purpose of this study is to propose an effective scripture practice methodology for member of Won Buddhism based on Christian Q.T and adult learner characteristics (andragogy). Until now, in Won Buddhism, there were textbooks and commentaries to help people practice the scriptures, but effective textbooks and methodologies were lacking. On the other hand, in Christianity, there are various Bible textbooks and methodologies for general believers, and one of them is Q.T. This method has an effective aspect at the learning characteristics of adult learners.Therefore, in this study, I examined the concept and significance of the scriptures, commentaries and methodology of Won Buddhism and Christianity in the aspect of adult learning. Through this, the five stages of understanding, meditating, applying, praying, and sharing were suggested. If additional research is conducted. it will be helpful in enhancing the faith and practice of Won Buddhists in general.

title_kr: 『원불교사상과 종교문화』에 게재된 논문의 연구동향 분석 - 원불교학·원불교교육학·원불교사회복지학을 중심으로 -
abstract_kr: The objective of this study is to examine if the Byeongjin(병진, 竝進) Thought which is one of the core principles of Won-Buddhist doctrine has been realized in the research area, by analyzing the research trend of theses published in『Won-Buddhist Thought and Religious Culture』 focusing on Won-Buddhist studies, Won-Buddhist pedagogy, and Won-Buddhist social welfare studies. For this, this study analyzed the theses published from Volume 1 in 1975 to Volume 86 in December 2020. The research trend was analyzed by dividing the theses in three academic areas into each period, research theme, research method, research type, and researcher.In the results of the analysis, the vulnerability and imbalance of researches on Won-Buddhist studies, Won-Buddhist pedagogy, and Won-Buddhist social welfare studies were verified. Based on such results of the analysis, this study presented the academic direction for the balanced development of Won-Buddhist studies, Won-Buddhist pedagogy, and Won-Buddhist social welfare studies in the future, by pointing out the imbalance and limitation of researches published in『Won-Buddhist Thought and Religious Culture』 and also presenting the consequential tasks.

title_kr: 근대한국종교의 理想村 건설운동 - 불법연구회 영광의 신흥분회를 중심으로 -
abstract_kr: This thesis tried to examine how the Modern Korean religions sought various ways for economic independence and trained spirituality, through the study of the activities of the Shinheung Branch in the Research Association佛法硏究會)The Sinheung village of Yeonggwang created in the early 19th century, lived a life in accordance with traditional Confucian order. By 1910s, they paid attention to the religious movement of Sotaesan Park Joong-bin, who was seek a new world of self-reliance and Perfect harmony of mind and body.Dongan and young people in the village created the Sinheung Savings Association imitating the Gilryong-ri Savings Association in Yeonggwang and tried to achieve economic independence and awakening of consciousness. Thus, in the spring of 1927, the Shinheung Branch of the the Research Association of Buddhadharma, was established, and since then, it has worked hard to open its mind and change lifestyle through the three monthly ceremonial meetings and try to various economic independence campaigns and has been promoted to an independent branch in 1935.These activities of the Shinheung Branch of the Illegal Research Society have important significance as the construction of Won-Buddhism’s Utopian Villages (理想村) practiced in the Research Association of Buddhadharma,

title_kr: 은(恩)으로 혐오 넘어서기 -지구인문학으로서 원불교학-
abstract_kr: This study discusses what viewpoint is required for going beyond hatred. Hatred is caused by unconscious anxiety that men may become people of low ability who are absolutely perfect due to corruption. Hatred has appeared in more multi-layered and complex forms due to the era of accelerated globalization these days.Philosophy for others that appeared as a new thinking method in the era of imperialism which did not consider others’ dignity focused on their absoluteness. And the viewpoint of globalogy plays the role as a solution of ‘global abhorrence phenomena’ by focusing on dignity and equality of global beings in the present era of globalization. Globalogy recommends people to be fascinated by the earth like Thomas Berry’s arguments and new materialists, post humanists, and Korean religionists and thinkers have presented thinking methods from the viewpoint of globalagy. Especially, grace thought is globalogy as practical learning as it recommends people to repay each other’s kindness based on all beings’ close independent relationship. But one concern is that beliefs balanced between ‘Dharmakāya Buddha’ and ‘Fourfold Grace’ are required. These beliefs will lead people to ‘utopia to make them give up hatred’.

title_kr: 원불교의 생태학적 상상력 - ‘개벽’의 생태 공공성을 중심으로 -
abstract_kr: Many Western ecological thinkers who are aware of the ecological crisis are in the midst of developing a practical movement by establishing various ecological theories. They are incorporating Eastern wisdom, especially Buddhism, into their ecological philosophy. Using this ecological discourse, I would like to read the ecological imagination of Won Buddhism about ‘living(life)’.The Gaebyeok of Sotaesan can be reborn as a “gaebyeok of Salim” in this era as an intermediate gaebyeok based on the consciousness of the CheYong theory, breaking away from the dualistic separation consciousness of mental and material gaebyeok. In other words, multiple reflections and interpretations of the spirituality and historicality of ‘Gaebyeok’ are required.Religion as an mediating structure can contribute to the creation of a culture of peaceful coexistence and ecological protection by publicizing ecological issues as a public good in solidarity with neighboring religions in a religious pluralistic society. In other words, if religions gather ecological wisdom through the universal problem of ‘Life’, which can be called the end of religion, it will have a positive effect on opening a sustainable civilization that is both postmodern and mutually beneficial. It can help to raise public citizenship.The metaphor of Gaebyeok can provide rich meaning to the various social roles of religion as a mediating structure when developing the “Gaebyeok Culture of Opening” aiming for “Saving Life and Peaceful Coexistence” to overcome the ecological crisis.Sotaesan diagnosed the situation where the material civilization was rapidly developing, while the mental civilization was immature, and advocated mental reform as a prescription. Now, at the time when a major transformation of the existing civilization itself, which has been pursued so far, is required, a new level of mental reform and another material reform must be sought. Creating a true civilized world in which all living creatures coexist peacefully is moderate since the establishment of the Bulbeop Research Association in 1924, but it will be a present succession of the spirit of Gaebyeok dreamed of by Sotaesan, who has been fiercely developing a social innovation movement.

title_kr: 중국 불성사상의 전개 과정 연구
abstract_kr: Chinese Buddhism has a few notable features-Prajñā, which insists on the Emptiness of all phenomena, Nirvāṇa Buddha Nature theory, which insists on the marvelous Being, and Zen Buddhism, which is the perfect manifestation of Buddhist ideology. The reason for the denial of self-nature in Prajñā is to emphasize of all phenomena that no existence is independent because all that makes up our world is in a state of Dependent Origination (Pratītyasamutpāda). Conversely, this logic emphasizes the emptiness of selfnature in order to help find self-nature. Using the Buddha Nature theory, this paper discusses the following questions: What is Buddha? What is the nature of Buddha? What is the likelihood that a Sattva can reach the enlightened state of Buddha? How can one reach the enlightened state of Buddha? And is it possible to reach the enlightened state of Buddha on one’s own power? Buddha Nature theory is one of the core theories of Buddhism that asserts “every life has the characteristics of a Buddha, and anyone can become a Buddha by revealing that Buddha Nature.” This ideology was not a problem during the reign of Guatama Buddha. Buddha Nature theory, which began to be discussed in earnest after the introduction of Buddhism to China, has since established itself as a basic foundation in all sects and ideology of Chinese Buddhism. In particular, Zen Buddhism speaks clearly on the concepts of Self-nature, Buddha Nature, and Own Mind, and asserts that these concepts “are complete and manifest by nature,” and there are personal differences in acquiring them. In this way, in the Zen Buddhism sect of Chinese Buddhism, the ideas of “self to find” and “self to lose” are relative concepts, and they are predicated on discovering that there is no manipulation, distinction between good and bad, discrimination, eternalism and annihilationism, or distinction between the common and holy. The quest for “Oneself” in Zen Buddhism eventually results in “Buddha Nature theory” and “The theory of Sudden Enlightenment,” Confronted with the question, “How will thinking of religion as a philosophical reason really help those who live a religious life?” this paper explores the need to understand the Chinese Buddha Nature ideology. Thus, after examining the Buddha Nature ideology based on the scriptures, this paper looked at how Buddhism was able to take root in China as a foreign religion, and the characteristics of the Chinese Buddha Nature ideology. This is due in large part because Buddha Nature ideology is at the root of all Buddhism in East Asia. This paper also examined the characteristics of Chinese Buddha Nature ideology, such as the Emptiness of all phenomena of Prajñā, the theory of Nirvana and Enlightenment, and Zen theory of Huineng, and reviewed the development of Buddhist Nature ideology in China.

title_kr: 『대승기신론』 일심사상의 비유법들에 대한 위상학적 독해
abstract_kr: The Book called Awakening Mahayana Faith says that One Mind as Buddhahood has two aspects, the mind essence and the mind phenomenon, and becomes a foolish person or an enlightened Buddha via externalization process of the One Mind. While the Book understands the various phenomena of our psychological mind as a manifestation of One Mind, it introduces the Buddhist-style mind practice methods leading to the enlightenment of One Mind. In order to make it easier for the people to approach One Mind, the Book tries to describes the above mentioned contents not only in a condensed and systematic manner, but also explains them using various metaphors including, sea-wave and mirror-image metaphor. In my opinion, those metaphors can only explain the content of the Book at a certain level, but cannot properly explain the more complex relationships of the contents. In this paper, I introduce an one-line drawing model as an alternative to those above mentioned models. I believe that the core messages of the Book can be better explained by this model. And this model can be interpreted as an example of topological theory. The conclusion of this paper is, therefore, that the core message of the Book and further the issue of awakening and mind practice can be discussed in line with the logic of topology.

title_kr: [논문철회] 하남 불교유적의 불교사적 위치
abstract_kr: Hanam has good topographical conditions as the Han River flows from the east to the north of Hanam City, where the Namhangang River and the Bukhangang River meet in Yangsuri, and many cultural heritages remain as well as the center of transportation and administration. In particular, Cheonwangsa Temple Site and Jeongjeongsa Temple Site have been known for 10 years through surface research and excavation research. A total of 17 Buddhist relics remain in Hanam, and many of them are found in Geumamsan Mountain. There are eight Geumamsan Mountain, three Gaeksan Mountain, one Cheongnyangsan Mountain, and one Iseongsan Mountain. Most of them are located in Geumamsan Mountain and Gaeksan Mountain, but there are also temples located in flat areas such as Cheonwangsa Temple and Dongsa Temple Site. Although many locations of Cheonwangsa Temple sites have been partially confirmed through recent excavation research, comprehensive and systematic excavation has not been carried out. Excavation of the verb map has been conducted, but many questions and the overall layout are still unknown. In order to solve this problem, it is necessary to review the details of the excavation of pieces.The remaining remains of Buddhist relics and literature show that it played an important role as a center of Buddhism since the Unified Silla Period.

title_kr: 「용궁부연록」을 통해본 김시습의 용궁(龍宮) 인식 - 용궁·삼신(三神) 개념의 고증과 함의를 중심으로-
abstract_kr: Yonggungbuyeonrok of Kim, Si Seup is a fantasy novel and biographical novel that reflects his experience. It is said that it imitated 「Sugunggyeonghoerok」 in the Mythology of Jeondeung, but Sugunggyeonghoerok is a popular novel for interests only. Yonggungbuyeonrok, on the other hand, has become a piece of literature on a whole new level with very elaborate composition and quality. It compared to the coup d’Etat of 1453 and sought for awakening in the mountains after leaving all desires behind, so it is completely different from Sugunggyeonghoerok. In this aspect, it is more related and similar to 「Wonsaengmongyurok」.Water and dreams in Yonggungbuyeonrok are organically connected and allow the main character to secure justification and probability to seek awakening beyond philosophy. The roughness and isolation of water were used to imply the dethroning and death of King Danjong, so awakening from the dreams symbolized the world of eternity in Buddhism and Taoism which Kim ultimately pursued.

title_kr: 「참동계(參同契)」의 촉목회도(觸目會道)에 대한 이해
abstract_kr: Shitou Xiqian’s Cantongqi is a gāthā that sheds light on the principle that all dharmas are equal, to admonish the situation of disputes and conflicts between the Southern school and the Northern school about “sudden cultivation and gradual cultivation”. He teaches that anyone can reach enlightenment if they practice it properly. In short, the enlightenment comes from everything that the eyes touch upon. This paper interprets the contents of Cantongqi in a rudimentary way and attempts to approach the meaning of Chumuhuidao through the analysis of old texts. Can(參) means that all of the numberless things in front of us appear in the form of a discriminatory shape. Dong(同) means the fundamental foundation behind the phenomenon is all equal. Qi(契) represents that the discrimination and the equal fundamental foundation are “mutually entering and mutually identifying - Huihubuhuihu”. Huihubuhuihu is the core concept of Cantongqi. Through the Huihubuhuihu, he says the way of being of all things that everything who exists by the dependent arising has an inseparable relationship with each other. And he says the basis of being of all things that everything lies within one equal mind-Tathatā. Through this realization of the way of being and the basis of being, one will be able to say that everything that touches one’s eyes is an expression of oneʼs own mind and an expression of the buddha-nature.

title_kr: 삼한과 그 식민지(왜: ‘불미국’, ‘야마국’) 그리고 ‘소도’ - 고조선과 삼한의 지도(‘부도문’) -
abstract_kr: The greatest puzzle of ancient Korean map history is, “Where are the locations of the 78 states of “SamHan)?” SamHan(三韓), or Three Han, is the collective name of the ByeonHan, JinHan, and MaHan confederacies. Shin, Chae-ho and Lee, Byeong-do postulated that the names of countries of 78 Guks[States] in SamHan(三韓) from to search “Han(韓)” story of Records of the Tree Kingdoms(『三國志』 220-280 CE, Cao Wei, Shu Han and Eastern Wu) were listed arbitrary and without logic. They also postulated that 55 Guks[States] were actually 54 and the 26 Guks[States] were actually 24 and the names of Guks[States] that were repeated was nothing more than a mistake. This paper sets and interprets the repetition in 78 Guks[States] in the Korean Peninsula as intentional in Boodomoon[coded map]. “Boodomoon(符圖文)” is a coded map character(符號地圖文字) that is marked on a map. The way to write them[Guks=States] is to order them intentionally. The characteristic of this is that there is intentional repetition that is mistaken as a mistake. Guks[States] where the same Guk[State] name is repeated in the default statement should be arranged to meet in one contact place when listing. First, the number of Guks[States] is 24, but because of the repetition by Mayeonguk(19, 22) and Goonmiguk(12, 13) it becomes 26 Guks[Staes] of ByeonHan-a and JinHan-a which are listed following the rule.Secondly, MaHan-a lists 55 Guks[States], but has a repetition with Makroguk, and draws up map of 54 Guks[States]. Next, a map (repetition of Yamaguk 9, 25, Noguk 6, 30, Bulmiguk etc.) is prepared for 30 Guks[States] in Wae-b, the colonies of MaHan-b and ByeonHan-b.Lastly, according to the coded map is that there is a Northern JinHan-c Shinji and 8 Guks[States] near Nakrang-goon[commandery] and Daebang-goon, while a 10,000 cavalry of Northern MaHan-c with Gogulyeo is near Hyeontogoon and Liaodong-goon.With this method, I found the location of MaHan-a “Geummaguk” of king Gijoon, MaHan-a “Bulmiguk 37” of the Youngsan River, ByeonHan-a “(ByeonJinMio)Yamaguk 14” of HamAn city, MaHan “(BoolSa)Boonsaguk 52” of Namwon city and Jangsu town, and the Northern JinHan-c “BoonShinRi ABulRye” ShinJiGuk. The ancient Korean nation of Gojoseon repeats the one Federal, three Heads, four ShinJis, millennium States in “Jin (Mak) Bun Joseon”, “Jin-Bun-sideStates (眞·番·旁衆國, zhēn·fān·páng zhōng guó)”, and “SamHan”. The SamHan Map is a miniature version of the 1 Federal, 3 Heads, 4 ShinJi, and Millennium States. The relationship between Hanguk(Ancient Korea: Byeonhan-a “(ByeonJinMio)YaMaGuk 14”, Mahan-a “Bulmiguk 37”) and Waeguk(Ancient Japan: Wae “Yamaguk 9, 25”, Wae“Bulmiguk 7”) analogous to that of parents and children, where the former Hanguk is the home country and the latter WaeGuk is the colony.
keywords_en: Samhan “Side States [pang zh?ng guo]” = “Jeen country [chen guo]”

title_kr: 대한제국시기 통감부의 일본불교화 일고찰 - 『종교에 관한 잡건철』‘한국관리의 불법행위에 관한 건’을 중심으로-
abstract_kr: “The Documents Binding Book about Religion (宗教に関する雑件綴),” written by the Japanese Resident-General of Korea in the Korean Empire, is an important historical document. It helps us understand Japan’s religious policy which allowed Joseon to control the independent Korean Empire. The Japanese Resident-General of Korea implemented a religious policy through close cooperation with Japanese religious organizations operating in Korea. In the process, tense relationships arose. Particularly, “the case on the illegal act of Korean management,” a document written in 1907, vividly conveys the process of forming an organizational network between the Japanese government and Japanese Buddhism at the time. This paper analyzes how Joseon Buddhism was converted to Japanese Buddhism by focusing on the “case on the illegal act of Korean administration” from the following perspectives.First, it analyzes the situation at the time of Japanese colonial religious policy or the “rules on the proclamation of religion.” Japan made Joseon a protectorate by signing the Japan-Korea Treaty in 1905. The Japanese Resident-General of Korea, established as a result, enacted this rule to manage how Japanese religious organizations operating in Korea were propagated. Second, this paper reconstructs the course of the incident by referring to newspaper articles and related materials for “the case on illegal act of Korean management” in “The Documents Binding Book about Religion.” In particular, the case has been examined three-dimensionally by obtaining additional information about the governor of Pyeongbuk Province; the governor of Nyŏngbyŏn County; Bohyeonsa Temple’s chief monk, Bobong; and Japanese monk Furukawa Taiko. Despite being central figures in the event, their personal information is not specified. Third, the study analyzes the actual state of the administrative petition (管理請願) and the subsequent Japanese religious policy. This case is an example of a so-called “petition for administration” based on Article 4 of the “Rule on the Proclamation of Religion.” Apart from Bohyeonsa Temple, many influential temples in Joseon faced a similar situation. This situation has been analyzed through pertinent historical materials, and the flow of Japanese religious policy up to “Sachallyeong,” which the Governor-General of Joseon used to suppress and control Korean Buddhism in 1911 after the annexation of Korea by Japan. This paper will be vital in understanding the background of the Governor-General of Joseon’s direct management of Joseon Buddhism through “Sachallyeong” after the annexation of Korea and Japan.

rules for the proclamation of religion

title_kr: 지구위험시대에 따른 교육의 방향전환 -‘세계시민주의교육’과 ‘생태시민교육’을 넘어서 ‘미래생존을 위한 교육’으로-
abstract_kr: This paper aims to set the direction of education in response to the crisis in Anthropocene that we are currently facing. It is to explore the direction of ‘Education for Future Survival’ as advocated by UNESCO.First, ‘Global Citizenship Education’ is the education that aims to cultivate ‘Global Citizenship’ for learners to solve common problems facing mankind today. However, this ‘Global Citizenship Education’ is revealing its obvious limitations in the era of planetary risk. This is because the education only regarded ‘human beings capable of rational action’ to be dignified and valuable, and showed contempt for non-human animals and the natural world that lacked such capabilities.Secondly, even though ‘Ecological Citizenship Education’ is ‘education that transcends territoriality’ and clearly offers various suggestions in the age of planetary dangers, it still did not deviate significantly from ‘anthropocentrism and human superiority’ that ‘perceives humans and nature in opposition’ and ‘nature is just a tool.’Finally, I have explored the direction of education required in the era of planetary risk. The direction was confirmed by the 7 visions of ‘Education for Future Survival: Learning to become with the world’, which UNESCO aims to realize by 2050. ‘Education for Future Survival’ is should be aimed at cooperating with more than human beings to restore this damaged Earth. That is ‘education to cultivate earthling with ecological capabilities’ and ‘education that practices learning to become one with the Earth ecosystem’.

title_kr: ‘지구학’에 대한 방법론적 고민, 장‘ 소-세계’를 중심으로
abstract_kr: The space of life, that is, the dwelling place, clearly proves that human beings are a being who lives in a place-world, regardless to where it is located or of its lifestyle. However, as the living spaces of modern people become urbanized, commercialized, globalized, and digitized, the number of displaced people one has lost their place-world is increasing every year. The place-world, the epicenter of life, is getting destroyed as we enter the era of neoliberalism that aims only for the economy-growth. Where the place-world is destroyed in this way, commercial spaces encouraging infinite consumption are built without exception. According to E. Relph’s concern, modern people are living in an era in which ‘placelessness’ is common.In this study, we judged that philosophical reflection on the concept of ‘place’ is necessary to reflect on the meaning of <Human Being = Being-in-Place>. According to E. S. Casey, “the place is our own.” In light of Casey’s opinion, we can see that “to do philosophy” is not different from the meanings of “philosophizing place” or “placing philosophy” in which we live. But, as is well known, philosophy has been immersed in a kind of “universalism of geometric space” that can be applied “everywhere” and “always”. That is why the philosophy of the Third World could not have its territoriality.The Third World became aware of this fact around the 2000s and invented the design of the new philosophy as part of the Decolonial Movement. That is the “local-based global philosophy”. The purpose of this study is to propose a methodology for how Korean philosophy can be globalized in connection with the local-based global philosophy movement of Global Studies, which has just started taking steps in Korea.

title_kr: 원광대학교 초대 총장 숭산 박길진 박사 관련 자료 해제 - 『조선일보』게재 숭산 관련기사를 중심으로-
숭산 박길진 총장을 모시고 -1975년 8월 12-14일/유성, 화양계곡-
박민영, 『이상설 평전: 독립운동의 대부』: (서울: 신서원, 2020)
관동대지진 조선인 학살은 ‘시무(時務)의 역사’ - 재일사학(在日史學)의 개척자 강덕상 선생을 그리워하며 -
봉공의 역사와 의미
abstract_kr: The purpose of this research is to find a meaning of the selfless service to the public in times of post-Corona. This research focuses on dogmatic approach to the selfless service to the public which is one of four doctrines of Won Buddhism and reviewing the history of the doctrine. This study mainly focuses on close examination of the doctrines distinctions and characteristics from the times when Won Buddhisms Society of Four Doctrine as a practical organization appeared to the establishment of the World Public Duty Organization.Summary: The Public Duty means that lower class pay back to the feudal lords geniality with the Public Duty. This term became generalized as an idealogical term during the Japanese colonial time to force Korean peoples public duty for the Japanese Emperors benevolence. The Public Duty in Won Buddhism was meaning of participating in the Public Service Movement by the Master Sotaesan and was conveyed as a meaning of Great Service to the entire humanity.The second master Jeongsan advocated the idea that a person truly possess the true public service mind only can participate in building a new country in his『 Theory of National Foundation』. The third master Daesan declared that the idea of the Selfless Service to the Public meant to be great effort for the public without self, but he declared it is the only practice to build the World of Ilwon with the purpose of Jaesangeusae(saving the lives by saving the ill world). And he made the Society of Four Doctrine as a main organization to execute the idea. Won Buddhisms Public Service organization in its changing period had to go through some hardships and confusions, but it became stabilized by the lead of the Department of Public Welfare. At the end of this study suggests the practical direction of Won Buddhism Society of Public Service in 21st century and the meaning of public service activity in post-Corona times.

title_kr: 『옥추보경』 말소부분과 구인 산상기도문 전문 복원
abstract_kr: The Okchu-gyeong is the core book used in the 9-person mountaintop pray. I have published several articles on this. One of its achievements is that it was able to clarify the reality of the 9 person prayer to some extent.There are a number of non-burnable collections, which show a clear evolutionary process for 9 mountaintop prayer. It was about the process of Korean translation of Okchu-gyeong and Dok-gyeong training according to the Tanjojik organization. In the process, however, the so-called “erased part” in the Okchubogyeong was an obstacle to analysis. Now, by revealing the full picture of this expungement mark, it is possible to establish a complete evolutionary process between the Other versions.The results of the restoration of the ink line are shown in Table 3, Finally, the Mount Prayer also presented the full text of prayer.
